title.narrative: Sustainable use of biomass to assist the development of Turkey#s economy towards a low-carbon development path

description.narrative: The Government of Turley expressed its interest for UNIDO to develop a project on "Sustainable Use of Biomass to Strengthen Economy in Turkey Towards a Low-Carbon Development Path", for possible funding under GEF6. The objective of this project is to trigger sectorial transformation by demonstrating the use of state-of-the-art bio-energy technologies to improve overall energetic performance, increase competitiveness and reduce greenhouse gas emissions in key economic sectors
